title: Not All Data Leakage Is Equal: A Controlled Benchmark of Evaluation Inflation in Tabular Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.18598v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data leakage is widely recognized as a threat to trustworthy machine-learning evaluation, yet the phrase covers mechanisms with very different statistical consequences. We present a controlled empirical benchmark that measures the inflation in held-out ROC-AUC caused by five common leakage mechanisms: global standardization, global median imputation, duplicate contamination, supervised feature selection before splitting, and target encoding before splitting. The benchmark spans six public datasets and two synthetic stress tests, three model families, and five repeated stratified train/test splits, yielding 600 paired clean-versus-leaked comparisons. To avoid pseudo-replication, inference is performed on dataset-level effects with cluster bootstrap confidence intervals and Holm-corrected one-sided Wilcoxon tests. Label-dependent or direct data-reuse mechanisms produced systematic optimism: global target encoding increased ROC-AUC by 2.42

translated_title: 并非所有数据泄露都相同：表格分类中评估膨胀的受控基准
translated_abstract: 数据泄露被广泛认为是威胁可信机器学习评估的因素，然而这一术语涵盖了统计后果截然不同的多种机制。我们提出了一个受控实证基准，用于测量五种常见泄露机制对留出集ROC-AUC造成的膨胀：全局标准化、全局中位数插补、重复样本污染、切分前的有监督特征选择，以及切分前的目标编码。该基准涵盖六个公开数据集和两个合成压力测试、三个模型族，以及五次重复的分层训练/测试切分，共产生600组干净与泄露条件下的配对比较。为避免伪重复，统计推断在数据集层面进行，采用聚类自助法置信区间和经Holm校正的单侧Wilcoxon检验。依赖于标签或直接复用数据的机制产生了系统性的乐观偏差：全局目标编码使ROC-AUC提高了2.42
tldr: 该论文通过涵盖600组配对比较的受控基准实验，量化了五种常见数据泄露机制对表格分类评估指标ROC-AUC的膨胀程度，发现依赖标签或复用数据的泄露机制（如切分前目标编码）会造成显著的系统性乐观偏差，而非所有泄露机制的危害程度相同。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a controlled benchmark of 600 paired comparisons quantifying how five common data leakage mechanisms inflate held-out ROC-AUC in tabular classification, showing that label-dependent mechanisms such as pre-split target encoding cause systematic evaluation inflation.
